description: Find Amtliches Bulletin passages by business, debate subject, speaker, session, council, or inclusive meeting dates. Supply at least a business, subject, speaker, session, or date bound. A text substring query additionally requires sessionId or a closed date range of at most 31 calendar days. Searches return metadata by default; includeText returns whole original passages, and an exact transcriptId defaults to full text. Metadata language never translates the speaker text; missing LanguageOfText remains unknown. Business searches cover every associated subject up to 20; larger debates require selecting subjectId through chparl_get_business section subjects. Follow nextOffset with unchanged filters.

businessId.description: Canonical eight-digit businessId from chparl_search_business or published short number; incompatible with subjectId and transcriptId.

council.description: N or S; exact German, French, and Italian council names are also accepted.

includeText.description: Return whole original text and references; defaults true for transcriptId and false for searches. Explicit false always wins.

language.description: Metadata language: de (default), fr, or it; original passage text stays in its published language.

limit.description: Search page request: metadata default 20/max 100, full text default 3/max 10; clamped with notice. Incompatible with transcriptId.

offset.description: Search starting row offset, default zero; use returned nextOffset. Incompatible with transcriptId.

personNumber.description: Exact speaker PersonNumber from chparl_search_members, distinct from Person.ID.

query.description: One original-text substring; requires sessionId or both dates spanning at most 31 inclusive calendar days.

sessionId.description: Exact positive decimal session identifier from chparl_list_reference topic sessions.

subjectId.description: Positive Int64 debate IdSubject string; incompatible with businessId and transcriptId.

transcriptId.description: Exact positive Int64 transcriptId from a previous chparl_search_transcripts result; only language and includeText may accompany it.

name: chparl_search_transcripts

effectiveFilters.description: Effective passage filters, disclosure mode, and applicable paging defaults.

businessId.description: Supplied business identifier resolved through all associated subjects.

includeText.description: Resolved original-text disclosure; exact default true, search default false.

limit.description: Effective page size for a search, absent for exact lookup.

offset.description: Starting passage offset for a search, absent for exact lookup.

query.description: Original-text substring after caller whitespace normalization.

transcriptId.description: Exact passage Int64 identifier; incompatible with search filters and paging.

effectiveLimit.description: Search page size after metadata or full-text clamping.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `search_scope_required`: No business, subject, speaker, session, date bound, or exact passage identifies the search. `text_scope_required`: A text query lacks a session or a valid closed date range of at most 31 days. `business_scope_too_broad`: A business has more than 20 associated debate subjects. `incompatible_fields`: Business and subject are combined, an exact passage ID is combined with search filters or paging, or dateFrom is after dateTo. `ambiguous_business_number`: A short business number resolves to multiple canonical businesses. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament returned HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: Exact-ID mode only: whether the selected passage exists.

guidance.description: How to discover a valid exact passage or missing business identifier.

hasMore.description: Whether passages remain after the delivered search page; absent in exact-ID mode.

nextOffset.description: Original offset plus actually delivered passages, when more remain.

notice.description: Combined clamp, whole-item fitting, empty-result, or indivisible-record guidance.

provenance.description: Attribution, publication status, and source download dates.

officialPublication.description: This server is an unofficial reproduction of the source.

sources.description: Every HTTP response contributing data, or each static source snapshot.

items.description: A source used to produce this result.

retrievedAt.description: Actual UTC download timestamp, or the date of a static source snapshot.

url.description: HTTPS source response or official snapshot document URL.

returnedCount.description: Passages actually delivered on a search page; absent in exact-ID mode.

scopeFound.description: Business searches only: whether the business exists, independently of published subjects or passages.

totalCount.description: Exact whole-scope passage count when supplied; absent when a business does not exist.

transcripts.description: Whole matching passages or zero-or-one exact-ID result, without shortening original fields.

items.description: One unshortened Bulletin passage or its metadata.

businessId.description: Published VoteBusinessNumber; not an exhaustive passage-to-business relationship.

endTime.description: Published passage end, retaining a source offset when supplied.

languageOfText.description: Original LanguageOfText label; absent means unknown, and compound labels remain intact.

meetingDate.description: Published calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, without an inferred timezone.

metadataLanguage.description: Selected metadata row language; original text is never translated.

personNumber.description: Published speaker PersonNumber, distinct from Person.ID.

references.description: Link and image references from returned original Text; relative attributes remain unexpanded.

items.description: One reference present in returned original HTML.

label.description: Original image alt attribute, when present.

originalUrl.description: Original reference attribute value, before HTML decoding.

url.description: Clickable absolute HTTP(S) target when the reference supplies one.

sourceUrl.description: Exact HTTPS OData composite-key passage URL.

speakerName.description: Original SpeakerFullName, without reconstructing a missing name.

startTime.description: Published passage start, retaining a source offset when supplied.

subjectId.description: Published debate IdSubject as an exact Int64 string.

text.description: Whole original Bulletin Text, preserving HTML, line endings, and the speaker language.

textSizeBytes.description: Actual original Text UTF-8 byte length, including zero for an existing empty string.

transcriptId.description: Transcript.ID as an exact signed Int64 decimal string.

type.description: Published open Bulletin passage type code.

voteId.description: Original VoteId string when the passage announces a vote.

title: Chparl Search Transcripts
